title: The nuclear atom: carbon-12
caption: Six protons and six neutrons make a tiny nucleus; six electrons occupy shells around it, two in the first and four in the second. Not to scale: the nucleus is about 100 000 times smaller than the atom.
alt: A carbon atom: a nucleus labelled 6 protons and 6 neutrons, with two electrons in the inner shell and four in the outer shell.
description: A small central nucleus labelled 6 p and 6 n.
Two circles around it are the shells: two electrons on the inner shell, four on the outer shell.

also.lesson: The development of the atomic model
